title: ONE RECORD
logline: An African research consortium proves the past is physically readable, then discovers that the same machine, pointed forward, is making the world behave as one thing.
source: The_Record_Series_Bible.docx v0.1 (prepared for AJ Greyling), transcribed to repo canon 2026-08-19
